title: 10th Sitting of Second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/10/2/2026).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 4/2/2026 to 6/2/2026).

Question by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to the Minister of Economic Development, Transport and Trade Mohamed Saeed: online services exist so people can get them anytime from anywhere, yet Transport Ministry services are unavailable through the portal outside official hours; why, and when will this be fixed?

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for Commissioner General of Taxation, under Article 8(a) of the Tax Administration Act (Law No. 3/2010), is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Continuation of the debate on the Maldives 2.0 Digital Transformation Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Gadhdhoo MP Mohamed Ali.
Continuation of the debate on the Digital Identity Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Alifushi MP Abdul Latheef Abdul Rahman.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting approved earlier minutes, questioned the transport minister on the online portal, sent the Commissioner General of Taxation nominee to committee, and continued debating the Maldives 2.0 Digital Transformation and Digital Identity bills.
